<?php require '/wordpress/wp-load.php';
$err = '/wordpress/wp-content/plugins/ceypay-payment-gateway/PREVIEW_ERROR.txt';
$ready = '/wordpress/wp-content/plugins/ceypay-payment-gateway/PREVIEW_READY.txt';
@unlink($err);
@unlink($ready);
try {

// Pretty permalinks so /shop/ and /checkout/ resolve.
update_option('permalink_structure','/%postname%/');

// Make sure WooCommerce pages and tables exist.
if ( class_exists('WC_Install') ) {
  WC_Install::install();
  if ( method_exists('WC_Install','create_pages') ) { WC_Install::create_pages(); }
}

// Skip the onboarding wizard so the store is immediately usable.
update_option('woocommerce_onboarding_profile', array('completed'=>true,'skipped'=>true));
update_option('woocommerce_task_list_hidden','yes');
update_option('woocommerce_task_list_complete','yes');
delete_transient('_wc_activation_redirect');

// Store basics.
update_option('woocommerce_currency','LKR');
update_option('woocommerce_default_country','LK:LK-1');
update_option('woocommerce_store_address','1 Test Street');
update_option('woocommerce_store_city','Colombo');
update_option('woocommerce_calc_taxes','no');
update_option('woocommerce_enable_guest_checkout','yes');

// Enable CeyPay in test mode: this uses the sandbox merchant ID and sandbox
// API, and exposes the "Simulate Success" button in the modal. Test mode is
// admin-only by design (see is_available()), and this preview is auto-logged
// in as admin.
update_option('woocommerce_ceypay_settings', array(
  'enabled'       => 'yes',
  'testmode'      => 'yes',
  'merchant_id'   => '',
  'show_branding' => 'yes'
));

// A product to buy. (get_page_by_title() is deprecated/removed on current
// WordPress, so query posts directly.)
$existing = get_posts(array('post_type'=>'product','title'=>'CeyPay Test Product','post_status'=>'any','numberposts'=>1));
if ( empty($existing) ) {
  $p = new WC_Product_Simple();
  $p->set_name('CeyPay Test Product');
  $p->set_regular_price('2500');
  $p->set_description('A sample product for exercising the CeyPay checkout modal.');
  $p->set_short_description('Sample product for the CeyPay preview.');
  $p->set_catalog_visibility('visible');
  $p->set_stock_status('instock');
  $p->set_virtual(true);
  $p->save();
  $product_id = $p->get_id();
} else {
  $product_id = $existing[0]->ID;
}

flush_rewrite_rules();

// Prove the store is actually usable before declaring the preview ready.
//
// A half-installed store is the failure this guards: WC_Install::install() can
// leave pages behind while the rest of setup dies, and PHP fatals (as opposed
// to Throwables) skip the catch below entirely, so "no exception" is not
// evidence that any of this ran. The checks below are the things a preview is
// useless without, and preview.sh waits for the receipt file rather than for
// the HTTP port, which comes up either way.
$checks = array(
  'woocommerce active' => class_exists('WooCommerce'),
  'shop page'          => wc_get_page_id('shop') > 0,
  'checkout page'      => wc_get_page_id('checkout') > 0,
  'product created'    => $product_id > 0,
  'product purchasable'=> ( $product_id > 0 && ($prod = wc_get_product($product_id)) && $prod->is_purchasable() && $prod->is_in_stock() ),
  'store api routes'   => in_array('/wc/store/v1/products', array_keys(rest_get_server()->get_routes()), true),
);
// is_available() hides the gateway from anyone but an administrator while test
// mode is on, and this step runs with no current user -- so check it as the
// admin the preview auto-logs in as, which is who will actually see checkout.
$admins = get_users(array('role' => 'administrator', 'number' => 1, 'fields' => 'ID'));
if ( ! empty($admins) ) { wp_set_current_user( $admins[0] ); }

$gateways = WC()->payment_gateways() ? WC()->payment_gateways()->payment_gateways() : array();
$checks['ceypay registered'] = isset($gateways['ceypay']);
$checks['ceypay available']  = isset($gateways['ceypay']) && $gateways['ceypay']->is_available();
$checks['admin user exists'] = ! empty($admins);

$failed = array_keys(array_filter($checks, function($ok){ return ! $ok; }));
if ( ! empty($failed) ) {
  file_put_contents($err, "setup incomplete: " . implode(', ', $failed) . "\n");
} else {
  file_put_contents($ready, "PRODUCT=$product_id\nWC=" . ( defined('WC_VERSION') ? WC_VERSION : '?' ) . "\nWP=" . get_bloginfo('version') . "\n");
}

} catch ( \Throwable $e ) {
  file_put_contents($err, get_class($e) . ': ' . $e->getMessage() . ' @ ' . $e->getFile() . ':' . $e->getLine() . "\n");
  throw $e;
}
